text.title: Go Project Structure Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply go-project-structure end-to-end.

step.name: scaffold-skeleton
step.action: Run templates/scaffold-go.sh to create the directory tree, go.mod, Makefile, Dockerfile and .golangci.yml. Keep the module root to go.mod, go.sum, Makefile, README.md, .gitignore, .golangci.yml, Dockerfile and .github/ — nothing else.
step.output: Empty skeleton with a clean top level

step.name: wire-entry-points
step.action: Each cmd/<name>/main.go does config.Load, constructor wiring, app.Run(ctx) — and nothing else. Partition internal/ per aggregate (orders, payments, users) with shared types in internal/shared; no feature package imports another feature package directly.
step.output: Thin entry points + internal package map
step.decision-gate: Any business logic still in cmd/ blocks the step — rule cmd-thin-entry-point.

step.name: author-makefile
step.action: Author the Makefile targets: build (all binaries), test, lint (golangci-lint run), run, docker-build. Every repeatable workflow gets a target.
step.output: Working Makefile, zero loose scripts at the root
step.decision-gate: If a workflow does not fit a Make target, add the target — do not add an ad-hoc script. Rule makefile-orchestrates.

step.name: write-vertical-slice
step.action: Write a complete CRUD slice end-to-end with tests at each layer.

step.name: enforce-import-boundaries
step.action: Configure the depguard rules in golangci-lint to block cross-feature imports and upward imports; run `go list -deps ./...` to confirm zero cycles. Wire both into CI.
step.output: Lint-clean project with a proven acyclic import graph
step.decision-gate: cycles_detected > 0 blocks the step — rule no-cyclic-dependencies.

step.name: audit-graceful-shutdown
step.action: Confirm srv.Shutdown + DB close + queue drain + ctx cancel order.
